satellites.description: Vendor credit rating, preferred status and active flag, with history kept so the vendor's state at order time can be reconstructed.
satellites.split_rationale: Coded status attributes that change faster and whose history is explicitly required. Holds the single ModifiedDate for the Vendor source.

satellites.name: sat_product_vendor_terms
satellites.description: Standing commercial terms agreed for a product from a vendor: lead time, standard price and order quantity bounds. History is kept for trend analysis.
satellites.split_rationale: Agreed terms that change slowly. Holds the single ModifiedDate for ProductVendor.

satellites.name: sat_product_vendor_receipt
satellites.description: Running purchasing figures for the supply relationship: last receipt cost and date, and quantity currently on order.
satellites.split_rationale: Running values that change with each order or receipt, much faster than the agreed terms.

satellites.name: sat_purchase_order_status
satellites.description: Purchase order status and revision number, with history kept so status transitions and revisions can be traced.
satellites.split_rationale: Workflow attributes that change with each revision or status transition. Holds the single ModifiedDate for PurchaseOrderHeader.

satellites.name: sat_purchase_order_details
satellites.description: Purchase order dates and financial totals: order date, estimated ship date, subtotal, tax, freight and total due.
satellites.split_rationale: Order dates and monetary totals, split from the workflow status attributes.

satellites.name: sat_purchase_order_line_details
satellites.description: Ordered terms of a purchase order line: due date, ordered quantity, unit price and line total.
satellites.split_rationale: Terms fixed when the order is placed, which rarely change afterwards.

satellites.name: sat_purchase_order_line_receipt
satellites.description: Cumulative received, rejected and accepted (stocked) quantities per line. History is kept so the quantity received as at a date, and partial deliveries, are visible.
satellites.split_rationale: Receipt progression that changes with each delivery. Holds the single ModifiedDate for PurchaseOrderDetail.

satellites.name: sat_ship_method_details
satellites.description: Shipping company name and agreed ship base and ship rate, with history kept so historical freight can be checked against the rates then in force. The rowguid replication identifier is left out.

satellites.name: sat_customer_details
satellites.description: Customer source trace and last-modified timestamp.

satellites.name: sat_business_entity_store_details
satellites.description: Store name.
satellites.split_rationale: Non-confidential store descriptors split from confidential demographics.

satellites.name: sat_business_entity_store_demographics
satellites.description: Store demographics (employees, annual sales, store type); confidential.
satellites.split_rationale: Commercially confidential classification.

satellites.name: sat_business_entity_sales_person_remuneration
satellites.description: Representative current quota, bonus and commission; access-restricted remuneration data.
satellites.split_rationale: Remuneration terms change rarely; restricted.

satellites.name: sat_business_entity_sales_person_performance
satellites.description: Representative operational running sales totals.
satellites.split_rationale: Running totals change with every sale — high rate of change.

satellites.name: sat_business_entity_sales_quota_history
satellites.description: Dated history of sales quotas per representative.

satellites.name: sat_sales_order_status
satellites.description: Order status, ship date and revision tracking.
satellites.split_rationale: Fast-changing fulfilment state.

satellites.name: sat_sales_order_details
satellites.description: Order descriptive attributes: dates, channel, customer PO number, financial account reference, comments.

satellites.name: sat_sales_order_amounts
satellites.description: Order financial amounts, taken as given from source.
satellites.split_rationale: Financial measures grouped separately from descriptive data.

satellites.name: sat_sales_order_payment
satellites.description: Credit card approval code for payment reconciliation; payment-sensitive.
satellites.split_rationale: Payment-sensitive classification.

satellites.name: sat_sales_order_line_details
satellites.description: Order line quantity, price, discount, line total and carrier tracking number.

satellites.name: sat_sales_territory_details
satellites.description: Territory name and geographic group.

satellites.name: sat_sales_territory_financials
satellites.description: Territory running sales and cost totals.
satellites.split_rationale: Running totals change far more often than descriptors.

satellites.name: sat_credit_card_details
satellites.description: Credit card type.

satellites.name: sat_credit_card_sensitive
satellites.description: Card number and expiry; restricted payment data.
satellites.split_rationale: Sensitive payment data isolated for access restriction.

satellites.name: sat_currency_details
satellites.description: Currency name.

satellites.name: sat_currency_rate_details
satellites.description: Average and end-of-day exchange rates.

satellites.name: sat_sales_reason_details
satellites.description: Sales reason description and reason category.

satellites.name: sat_special_offer_details
satellites.description: Special offer description, discount, type, category, quantity thresholds and validity period.

satellites.name: sat_shopping_cart_product_details
satellites.description: Cart item identifier, quantity and creation timestamp.

satellites.name: sat_sales_tax_rate_details
satellites.description: Tax rate description, tax type and rate amount.

satellites.name: sat_business_entity_sales_territory_assignment_effectivity
satellites.description: Active period of a representative's territory assignment; open-ended while current.

satellites.name: sat_business_entity_sales_territory_assignment_details
satellites.description: Last-modified trace of territory assignment records.

satellites.name: sat_business_entity_credit_card_details
satellites.description: Last-modified trace of person-card associations.

satellites.name: sat_special_offer_product_details
satellites.description: Last-modified trace of offer-product coverage.

satellites.name: sat_country_region_currency_details
satellites.description: Last-modified trace of country/region-currency associations.

satellites.name: sat_sales_order_sales_reason_details
satellites.description: Last-modified trace of order-sales reason associations.

contracts.name: CountryRegionCurrency
contracts.doc: Mapping between a country/region and the currency used there, staged from the source CountryRegionCurrency table. The contract enforces the declared schema and business-key integrity; ownership and agreement are to be finalized at the human review checkpoint.

schema.name: CountryRegionCode
schema.description: Code identifying the country or region that uses the currency. Part of the business key.

schema.name: CurrencyCode
schema.description: Code identifying the currency used in the country or region. Part of the business key.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the source record was last modified.

contracts.name: CreditCard
contracts.doc: Source-to-staging asset for credit card records from the Sales source schema. Each record describes a payment card (type, number, expiration month and year) and when it was last modified. The contract enforces the declared schema, business-key uniqueness and not-null rules; value-level semantics are advisory (soft) unless a requirement mandates otherwise. Ownership and agreement status are to be confirmed at the human-in-the-loop checkpoint.

schema.name: CreditCardID
schema.description: Unique identifier for a credit card record; business key of the asset.

schema.name: CardType
schema.description: Type or brand of the credit card. The allowed value set has not been specified in the requirements.

schema.name: CardNumber
schema.description: The credit card number. Sensitive payment data; handling and masking requirements have not been specified and need human review.

schema.name: ExpMonth
schema.description: Expiration month of the credit card.

schema.name: ExpYear
schema.description: Expiration year of the credit card.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the record was last modified in the source.

contracts.name: Currency
contracts.doc: Reference data for currencies, sourced from the Sales.Currency table and staged as-is. The contract enforces the declared schema and the CurrencyCode business key. Ownership and agreement status are to be confirmed at the human-in-the-loop checkpoint.

schema.name: CurrencyCode
schema.description: Code that identifies the currency. This is the business key of the asset.

schema.name: Name
schema.description: Name of the currency.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time when the source record was last modified.

contracts.name: CurrencyRate
contracts.doc: Currency exchange rates between a source and target currency for a given date, staged from the source CurrencyRate table. The contract enforces the declared schema, business key and not-null rules; value-level semantics are not yet specified by requirements and are left for producer/consumer negotiation.

schema.name: CurrencyRateID
schema.description: Unique identifier of the currency rate record.

schema.name: CurrencyRateDate
schema.description: Date and time the exchange rate was obtained.

schema.name: FromCurrencyCode
schema.description: Currency code of the source currency being converted from; references Currency.CurrencyCode.

schema.name: ToCurrencyCode
schema.description: Currency code of the target currency being converted to; references Currency.CurrencyCode.

schema.name: AverageRate
schema.description: Average exchange rate for the day.

schema.name: EndOfDayRate
schema.description: Final exchange rate for the day.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the record was last modified in the source.

contracts.name: Customer
contracts.doc: Customer source-to-staging asset: a customer of the sales business, which may be an individual (linked via PersonID) or a store (linked via StoreID). The contract enforces the declared schema, business-key uniqueness and not-null rules; value-level semantics are advisory pending producer/consumer review.

schema.name: CustomerID
schema.description: Unique identifier of the customer record.

schema.name: PersonID
schema.description: Identifier of the individual person associated with the customer; may be absent for store customers.

schema.name: StoreID
schema.description: Identifier of the store associated with the customer; may be absent for individual customers.

schema.name: TerritoryID
schema.description: Identifier of the sales territory the customer belongs to.

schema.name: AccountNumber
schema.description: Customer account number used for business reference.

schema.name: rowguid
schema.description: Globally unique identifier (GUID) for the row, used for replication/row identification.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the source record was last modified.

contracts.name: PersonCreditCard
contracts.doc: Association between a person (identified by BusinessEntityID) and a credit card (CreditCardID) in the sales source, staged from the PersonCreditCard source table. The contract enforces the declared schema and business-key integrity; ownership and agreement are to be confirmed at the human-in-the-loop checkpoint.

schema.name: BusinessEntityID
schema.description: Identifier of the business entity (person) that holds the credit card. Part of the association key with CreditCardID.

schema.name: CreditCardID
schema.description: Identifier of the credit card linked to the business entity. References the CreditCard source asset.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the source record was last modified.

contracts.name: SalesOrderDetail
contracts.doc: Line-item level detail of sales orders, one record per product line within a sales order (source: SalesOrderDetail). The contract enforces the declared schema, business-key uniqueness and not-null on keys; value-level semantics are advisory pending producer/consumer review.

schema.name: SalesOrderID
schema.description: Identifier of the parent sales order (references SalesOrderHeader).

schema.name: SalesOrderDetailID
schema.description: Identifier of the individual line item within the sales order.

schema.name: CarrierTrackingNumber
schema.description: Shipment tracking number assigned by the carrier for this line item. May be absent if not yet shipped.

schema.name: OrderQty
schema.description: Quantity of the product ordered on this line item.

schema.name: ProductID
schema.description: Identifier of the product ordered on this line (references Product).

schema.name: SpecialOfferID
schema.description: Identifier of the special offer applied to this line (references SpecialOffer).

schema.name: UnitPrice
schema.description: Selling price of a single unit of the product at the time of order.

schema.name: UnitPriceDiscount
schema.description: Discount applied to the unit price for this line item.

schema.name: LineTotal
schema.description: Line total for the item (quantity times discounted unit price); derived value in source.

schema.name: rowguid
schema.description: Globally unique row identifier (GUID) used by the source system for replication.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the source record was last modified.

contracts.name: SalesOrderHeader
contracts.doc: Sales order header records staged from the source SalesOrderHeader table. Each record is one sales order, with its dates, status, customer, sales person, territory, address, shipping, payment and currency references, and monetary totals. The contract enforces the declared schema and business keys. No value-level semantic constraints are asserted, because the requirements state none. Field types and descriptions are bootstrapped from column names only and need human review. Ownership is not set here and is to be agreed at the human-in-the-loop checkpoint.

schema.name: SalesOrderID
schema.description: Identifier of the sales order. Business key of the header.

schema.name: RevisionNumber
schema.description: Revision number of the sales order.

schema.name: OrderDate
schema.description: Date the sales order was placed.

schema.name: DueDate
schema.description: Date the order is due to the customer.

schema.name: ShipDate
schema.description: Date the order was shipped.

schema.name: Status
schema.description: Status code of the order. The allowed values are not stated in the requirements.

schema.name: OnlineOrderFlag
schema.description: Flag indicating whether the order was placed online. The representation is not stated in the requirements.

schema.name: SalesOrderNumber
schema.description: Business-facing sales order number.

schema.name: PurchaseOrderNumber
schema.description: Customer purchase order number reference.

schema.name: AccountNumber
schema.description: Customer account number associated with the order.

schema.name: CustomerID
schema.description: Reference to the customer who placed the order.

schema.name: SalesPersonID
schema.description: Reference to the sales person responsible for the order.

schema.name: TerritoryID
schema.description: Reference to the sales territory of the order.

schema.name: BillToAddressID
schema.description: Reference to the billing address of the order.

schema.name: ShipToAddressID
schema.description: Reference to the shipping address of the order.

schema.name: ShipMethodID
schema.description: Reference to the shipping method used for the order.

schema.name: CreditCardID
schema.description: Reference to the credit card used for payment.

schema.name: CreditCardApprovalCode
schema.description: Approval code returned by the credit card processor.

schema.name: CurrencyRateID
schema.description: Reference to the currency rate applied to the order.

schema.name: SubTotal
schema.description: Order subtotal amount.

schema.name: TaxAmt
schema.description: Tax amount on the order.

schema.name: Freight
schema.description: Shipping (freight) charge on the order.

schema.name: TotalDue
schema.description: Total amount due for the order.

schema.name: Comment
schema.description: Free-text comment on the order.

schema.name: rowguid
schema.description: Row-level globally unique identifier from the source system.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the source record was last modified.

contracts.name: SalesOrderHeaderSalesReason
contracts.doc: Association between a sales order header and the sales reason(s) recorded for that order (many-to-many link between SalesOrderHeader and SalesReason). Contract enforces the declared schema, business-key uniqueness and not-null on key fields; ownership is to be confirmed at the human-in-the-loop checkpoint.

schema.name: SalesOrderID
schema.description: Identifier of the sales order header this reason applies to; references SalesOrderHeader.SalesOrderID.

schema.name: SalesReasonID
schema.description: Identifier of the sales reason recorded for the order; references SalesReason.SalesReasonID.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the record was last modified in the source system.

contracts.name: SalesPerson
contracts.doc: Staging asset for SalesPerson: one record per sales person, with territory assignment, quota, bonus, commission percentage and sales totals. The contract enforces the declared schema, business key and not-null rules; ownership and agreement are left to human review.

schema.name: BusinessEntityID
schema.description: Identifier of the business entity (employee) that is the sales person; business key for the asset.

schema.name: TerritoryID
schema.description: Identifier of the sales territory currently assigned to the sales person, if any.

schema.name: SalesQuota
schema.description: Projected sales target for the sales person, if one is set.

schema.name: Bonus
schema.description: Bonus amount due to the sales person.

schema.name: CommissionPct
schema.description: Commission percentage received per sale.

schema.name: SalesYTD
schema.description: Sales total for the sales person year to date.

schema.name: SalesLastYear
schema.description: Sales total for the sales person in the previous year.

schema.name: rowguid
schema.description: Globally unique row identifier (GUID) for the record.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the record was last modified.

contracts.name: SalesPersonQuotaHistory
contracts.doc: Historical record of sales quotas assigned to sales people, one row per sales person and quota date. Source-to-staging contract for SalesPersonQuotaHistory; enforces schema, primary-key and not-null constraints. Ownership and agreement are to be confirmed at the human-in-the-loop checkpoint.

schema.name: BusinessEntityID
schema.description: Identifier of the sales person (business entity) the quota applies to.

schema.name: QuotaDate
schema.description: Date on which the sales quota took effect for the sales person.

schema.name: SalesQuota
schema.description: Sales quota amount assigned to the sales person for the quota date.

schema.name: rowguid
schema.description: Unique row identifier (GUID) used by the source system.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Timestamp when the source row was last modified.

contracts.name: SalesReason
contracts.doc: Lookup of reasons a customer gave for placing a sales order (source: SalesReason). The contract enforces the declared schema, the business key SalesReasonID, and not-null rules; no further value-level constraints are stated in the requirements.

schema.name: SalesReasonID
schema.description: Unique identifier of the sales reason; business key of the asset.

schema.name: Name
schema.description: Name or description of the sales reason.

schema.name: ReasonType
schema.description: Category of the sales reason.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the record was last modified in the source.

contracts.name: SalesTaxRate
contracts.doc: Sales tax rate definitions by state/province, as staged from the source SalesTaxRate table. The contract enforces the declared schema, primary key and not-null constraints; no value-level requirements beyond these were stated.

schema.name: SalesTaxRateID
schema.description: Identifier of the sales tax rate record.

schema.name: StateProvinceID
schema.description: Identifier of the state or province to which the tax rate applies.

schema.name: TaxType
schema.description: Code indicating the type/category of tax the rate represents.

schema.name: TaxRate
schema.description: Tax rate applied for this record.

schema.name: Name
schema.description: Name of the sales tax rate.

schema.name: rowguid
schema.description: Globally unique identifier for the row.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the record was last modified.

contracts.name: SalesTerritory
contracts.doc: Sales territory reference data from the source system, one record per territory, with its region and group, year-to-date and prior-year sales and cost figures. The contract enforces the declared schema and business key; ownership and agreement are pending human review.

schema.name: TerritoryID
schema.description: Unique identifier of the sales territory.

schema.name: Name
schema.description: Name of the sales territory.

schema.name: CountryRegionCode
schema.description: Code identifying the country or region the territory belongs to.

schema.name: Group
schema.description: Geographic grouping that the sales territory belongs to.

schema.name: SalesYTD
schema.description: Sales in the territory year to date.

schema.name: SalesLastYear
schema.description: Sales in the territory in the previous year.

schema.name: CostYTD
schema.description: Business costs in the territory year to date.

schema.name: CostLastYear
schema.description: Business costs in the territory in the previous year.

schema.name: rowguid
schema.description: Globally unique row identifier (GUID) for the source record.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the source record was last modified.

contracts.name: SalesTerritoryHistory
contracts.doc: Source-to-staging asset recording the history of sales territory assignments for sales people: which sales person (BusinessEntityID) was assigned to which territory (TerritoryID) over a start/end date period. The contract enforces the declared schema, business-key primary key and not-null constraints; value-level semantics are raised as soft alerts. Ownership and agreement are pending human review.

schema.name: BusinessEntityID
schema.description: Identifier of the sales person (business entity) assigned to the territory.

schema.name: TerritoryID
schema.description: Identifier of the sales territory the sales person was assigned to.

schema.name: StartDate
schema.description: Date and time when the sales person's assignment to the territory began.

schema.name: EndDate
schema.description: Date and time when the assignment to the territory ended; likely empty while the assignment is current.

schema.name: rowguid
schema.description: Row-level globally unique identifier (GUID) for the record.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time when the record was last modified in the source.

contracts.name: ShoppingCartItem
contracts.doc: Items placed in an online shopping cart, as staged from the Sales.ShoppingCartItem source table. Each row is one product line in a cart. The contract enforces the declared schema, business-key uniqueness and not-null rules (applied deterministically); no value-level thresholds are stated in the requirements.

schema.name: ShoppingCartItemID
schema.description: Unique identifier for a shopping cart item row.

schema.name: ShoppingCartID
schema.description: Identifier of the shopping cart that the item belongs to.

schema.name: Quantity
schema.description: Number of units of the product in the shopping cart.

schema.name: ProductID
schema.description: Identifier of the product added to the shopping cart.

schema.name: DateCreated
schema.description: Date and time when the item was added to the shopping cart.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time when the source row was last modified.

contracts.name: SpecialOffer
contracts.doc: Sales discount offers (special offers) from the source-to-staging load, one record per offer, identified by SpecialOfferID. Describes the offer, its discount percentage, type and category, validity window and quantity range. Contract enforces the declared schema, primary key and not-null rules; value-level semantics are soft alerts pending producer/consumer review.

schema.name: SpecialOfferID
schema.description: Unique identifier of the special offer.

schema.name: Description
schema.description: Description of the special offer.

schema.name: DiscountPct
schema.description: Discount percentage applied by the special offer.

schema.name: Type
schema.description: Type of discount offered by the special offer.

schema.name: Category
schema.description: Group or category the special offer belongs to.

schema.name: StartDate
schema.description: Date and time the special offer becomes valid.

schema.name: EndDate
schema.description: Date and time the special offer stops being valid.

schema.name: MinQty
schema.description: Minimum order quantity required for the discount to apply.

schema.name: MaxQty
schema.description: Maximum order quantity to which the discount applies. May be unset when there is no upper limit.

schema.name: rowguid
schema.description: Row-unique GUID identifying the record in the source system.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the record was last modified in the source.

contracts.name: SpecialOfferProduct
contracts.doc: Association between special offers and the products they apply to (many-to-many link). The contract enforces the declared schema and business-key uniqueness; ownership and agreement are left to human review.

schema.name: SpecialOfferID
schema.description: Identifier of the special offer; references the SpecialOffer asset.

schema.name: ProductID
schema.description: Identifier of the product covered by the special offer.

schema.name: rowguid
schema.description: Globally unique row identifier (GUID) for the record.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the record was last modified.

contracts.name: Store
contracts.doc: Source-to-staging asset representing a store (retail customer) in the sales domain, keyed by BusinessEntityID. The contract enforces the declared schema and key/not-null rules; ownership and agreement are to be finalized at the human-in-the-loop checkpoint.

schema.name: BusinessEntityID
schema.description: Identifier of the store's business entity; business key of the Store asset.

schema.name: Name
schema.description: Name of the store.

schema.name: SalesPersonID
schema.description: Identifier of the sales person assigned to the store (references a sales person business entity).

schema.name: Demographics
schema.description: Demographic survey information about the store. Structure and format are not specified in the requirements; needs human review.

schema.name: rowguid
schema.description: Row-level globally unique identifier for the record.

schema.name: ModifiedDate
schema.description: Date and time the record was last modified in the source.

# ADR-0001: Data Vault model derived from requirements

**Status:** Proposed
**Date:** 2026-10-22
**Decision makers:** Vault-Agent (generated) — pending human review

## Context

This model was derived automatically by the Vault-Agent pipeline from 203 requirement(s) and 21 business key candidate(s). It records the Data Vault 2.0 structures the modeler chose and traces each back to the requirements that justify it.

## Decision

Model the following Data Vault 2.0 structures.

### Hubs (11)

- **hub_customer** — business key `AccountNumber`. Customer, identified by the account number assigned by the accounting system (source-computed, taken as given). _(requirements: REQ-001, REQ-051-3, REQ-052-2)_
- **hub_sales_order** — business key `SalesOrderNumber`. Sales order, identified by its unique sales order number. _(requirements: REQ-014, REQ-051-3)_
- **hub_sales_order_line** — business key `sales_order_line`. Sales order line, identified within its order by an incremental number per product sold. _(requirements: REQ-048, REQ-044-2)_
- **hub_sales_territory** — business key `TerritoryID`. Sales territory catalogue entry. _(requirements: REQ-072, REQ-005, REQ-018)_
- **hub_credit_card** — business key `CreditCardID`. Credit card register entry, identified by the card record held in the operational system. _(requirements: REQ-079)_
- **hub_currency** — business key `CurrencyCode`. Currency identified by its ISO currency code. _(requirements: REQ-022-2)_
- **hub_currency_rate** — business key `currency_rate`. Daily exchange rate converting from one currency to another on a given day. _(requirements: REQ-024-2, REQ-025-2, REQ-059-2, REQ-016-3)_
- **hub_sales_reason** — business key `SalesReasonID`. Sales reason catalogue entry. _(requirements: REQ-058)_
- **hub_special_offer** — business key `SpecialOfferID`. Special offer (promotional code) catalogue entry. _(requirements: REQ-054, REQ-008-2)_
- **hub_shopping_cart** — business key `ShoppingCartID`. Shopping cart grouping cart items; not linked to customer or order. _(requirements: REQ-001-2, REQ-002-2, REQ-061-2, REQ-062-2)_
- **hub_sales_tax_rate** — business key `SalesTaxRateID`. Sales tax rate register entry. _(requirements: REQ-035-2)_

### Links (22)

- **link_customer_business_entity** — connects hub_customer, hub_business_entity (person), hub_business_entity (store). Customer to the person (individual customer) or store (store customer) it represents. _(requirements: REQ-002, REQ-003, REQ-004, REQ-052-2, REQ-040-3)_
- **link_customer_sales_territory** — connects hub_customer, hub_sales_territory. Sales territory in which the customer is located. _(requirements: REQ-005, REQ-007, REQ-051-2, REQ-020-3)_
- **link_business_entity_store_sales_person** — connects hub_business_entity (store), hub_business_entity (sales_person). Sales representative assigned to a reseller store. _(requirements: REQ-011, REQ-053-2, REQ-020-3, REQ-034-3)_
- **link_sales_order_customer** — connects hub_sales_order, hub_customer. Customer who placed the sales order. _(requirements: REQ-015, REQ-034, REQ-041-2)_
- **link_sales_order_sales_person** — connects hub_sales_order, hub_business_entity (sales_person). Sales representative who created the order (absent for online orders). _(requirements: REQ-017, REQ-033, REQ-042-2)_
- **link_sales_order_sales_territory** — connects hub_sales_order, hub_sales_territory. Territory in which the sale was made, as recorded on the order (distinct from customer and representative territory). _(requirements: REQ-018, REQ-019, REQ-032, REQ-043-2)_
- **link_sales_order_address** — connects hub_sales_order, hub_address (bill_to), hub_address (ship_to). Billing and shipping addresses used for the order. _(requirements: REQ-027, REQ-028, REQ-063-2)_
- **link_sales_order_ship_method** — connects hub_sales_order, hub_ship_method. Shipping method chosen for the order. _(requirements: REQ-029, REQ-064-2)_
- **link_sales_order_credit_card** — connects hub_sales_order, hub_credit_card. Credit card used to pay for the order, where one was used. _(requirements: REQ-042, REQ-044, REQ-048-2, REQ-086)_
- **link_sales_order_currency_rate** — connects hub_sales_order, hub_currency_rate. Exchange rate applied to the order, where not in base currency. _(requirements: REQ-045, REQ-047, REQ-050-2, REQ-028-2, REQ-031-2)_
- **link_sales_order_line_product_special_offer** — connects hub_sales_order_line, hub_sales_order, hub_product, hub_special_offer.
